description_original: Enjoy videos and photos on the go with this LG G Flex 2 LGLS996RDKT cell phone, which features a 5.5" LCD touch screen for easy operation and clear, detailed visuals with up to 1920 x 1080 resolution. Fast AC Wi-Fi simplifies on-the-go Internet access. Sprint Easy Pay option available in store. Learn more ›
